What it solves
Built around problems Indian investors actually face

Northstar was designed around the real frustrations of tracking a mutual fund portfolio in India — not around generic investing workflows from Western apps.

I don't know if I'm on track for retirement
Goal Dashboard with corpus projection See your current corpus vs the Floor / Base / Ceiling tiers in real time. The Retirement Planner generates a glide path and tracks progress against each tier — 25×, 30×, and 40× annual expenses.
My MF data is spread across CAMS, KFintech, and Excel
Import from any source, unified view Import transaction files from CAMS, KFintech, and MF Central directly. All sources merge into one portfolio. Add EPF, NPS, PPF, and FD data for a complete picture.
I pay too much tax on LTCG
FIFO tax engine, loss harvesting, redemption simulator The tax engine calculates your exact LTCG position using FIFO lot accounting. The Redemption Simulator shows the tax impact of any redemption before you execute it. Loss harvesting alerts flag opportunities proactively.
I don't know if my funds are still good
Annual Fund Review with Hold / Exit verdicts The Annual Fund Review evaluates every fund on quality (rolling returns, expense ratio, AUM) and timeline fit. Each fund gets a clear Hold / Monitor / Phased Exit / Exit Now verdict. Run it every April.
I make emotional decisions during market crashes
Behaviour Analytics with rupee cost of decisions Behaviour Analytics compares what your funds earned vs what your portfolio actually captured — and converts the gap into a rupee figure. Seeing the cost of panic selling in hard numbers is more effective than any advice.
I want to track my whole family in one app
Multi-member support, shared goals Add each family member separately. Create shared goals with multiple contributors. See a household summary in one view — separate PAN-level tax analysis for each person.
Key features
Everything in one place

No feature is bolted on. Every part feeds the others — imports flow into goals, goals feed the retirement planner, tax figures pull from the same lot data as the portfolio.

🎯
Goal-based portfolio tracking
Create goals (retirement, education, home purchase, emergency fund), map your funds to them, and track each goal's corpus separately. The Goal Dashboard shows on-track status, SIP gap, and years to target for every goal — with a speedometer gauge per goal and a family-level summary when tracking multiple members.
📈
Portfolio analysis with XIRR and rolling returns
Money-weighted return (XIRR) per fund and for the full portfolio, compared against the NIFTY 50 TRI benchmark. Rolling 1Y, 3Y, and 5Y returns show consistency over time — not just point-to-point. Includes contribution attribution (how much each fund contributed to overall returns) and daily/weekly/monthly/YTD performance.
🔬
Deep fund analysis tools
Screen the entire AMFI fund universe by category, return, drawdown, and recovery time. Compare any two or more funds side by side — NAV charts, risk-return scatter vs peers, Sharpe ratio trend, rolling return standard deviation. Ulcer Index shows downside pain, not just volatility. Consistency score (win rate, Hurst exponent) separates funds that deliver smooth returns from those with erratic peaks.
🔗
Correlation and diversification analysis
Inter-fund correlation heatmap identifies pairs above 0.85 — funds that move together and provide no real diversification benefit. Portfolio Builder simulates adding new funds and shows the impact on the efficient frontier before you invest.
💰
LTCG / STCG tax analysis with redemption simulator
Exact FIFO lot accounting for equity and debt mutual funds and stocks. Calculates realised and unrealised gains per lot, tracks the ₹1.25L LTCG exemption, flags loss-harvesting opportunities with recommended actions, and simulates the tax impact of any redemption before you execute it. Multi-year tax projection included.
📋
Annual Fund Review with Hold / Exit verdicts
Two-gate analysis per fund: Gate 1 checks fund quality (rolling returns vs benchmark, consistency, drawdown); Gate 2 checks timeline fit (is this fund category appropriate for how many years are left?). Clear Hold / Monitor / Phased Exit / Exit Now verdict per fund, per member. Direct links from each verdict to Equity Portfolio (to redeem) and Tax Corner (to check lot impact first).
🏖️
Retirement planning with corpus projection
Projects the corpus needed at retirement based on your age, expenses, and inflation. AI-generated glide path shows how to shift equity to debt as you approach retirement. Bucket strategy simulator models a 3-bucket withdrawal structure and stress-tests it against crashes and high inflation. Corpus tiers show where you stand: Floor (25×), Base (30×), Ceiling (40×), and the financial independence zone (above 40×).
🧠
Behaviour analytics — the rupee cost of emotional decisions
Analyses your actual transaction history to detect behavioural biases: panic selling during crashes, return chasing after rallies, low SIP consistency, and the disposition effect (selling winners early, holding losers). The Behaviour Gap shows how much these decisions have cost you vs a fully-invested buy-and-hold baseline — in rupees, not percentages.
🔔
Alert Center — weekly portfolio health in one screen
Single page covering six alert categories: fund concentration risk, stale NAV data, goal funding gaps, tax timing windows (LTCG eligibility and loss-harvesting candidates with specific action steps), and behaviour pattern alerts. Filters to the active family member so alerts are always relevant.
👨‍👩‍👧
Multi-member family support
Separate portfolios, goals, debt instruments, and retirement plans per member. Shared goals with per-contributor corpus breakdown (how much each member has invested towards a joint goal). Household summary shows total family corpus, on-track count, and most urgent action. Tax analysis always per PAN — never combined by accident.
📥
Import from CAMS, KFintech, MF Central, EPF, NPS, PPF
Imports CAMS and KFintech consolidated account statements (Excel, JSON, or PDF), MF Central Excel, EPF UMANG passbook PDF, NPS CRA CSV, PPF bank statement PDF, and Superannuation statements. Fuzzy name matching resolves fund names to AMFI codes automatically. Duplicate detection prevents double entries on re-import.
🔒
Offline and private — your data stays on your machine
All data is stored in a local PostgreSQL database. Nothing is uploaded to any server. The app runs without internet after setup (internet only needed for NAV updates and optional AI features). You own your data entirely — back it up, restore it, move it to a new machine at any time.

Common Questions
Before you decide

Questions from prospective buyers — answered directly.

🔄 After my first CAMS import, how do I handle monthly updates when I buy or sell?
Just re-import. Upload your new monthly statement and the software automatically skips anything already in the database — it only inserts new transactions. Duplicate detection matches on date + fund + units, so re-uploading a full history statement is safe. Takes under a minute.
📊 Can it show data across all asset classes — direct equity, equity MFs, debt MFs, and hybrid — grouped together?
Partial support today. Portfolio Analysis shows MF allocation by category with XIRR per category. The Debt Tracker covers EPF, NPS, PPF, and FDs. Goal Dashboard shows equity vs debt split per goal. A consolidated all-asset-class view (Net Worth Tracker) is on the roadmap.
🔗 Does it show MF overlaps so I can decide whether to consolidate two funds?
Yes — the Correlation page shows an inter-fund correlation heatmap. Funds with correlation above 0.85 are flagged as redundant (they move together, so holding both adds little diversification). The page ranks the most correlated pairs so you can decide. Stock-level overlap (both funds hold HDFC Bank at 8%) is not yet available but is planned.
